    LATIN CORE THURSDAYS: Addly Muff ☆ Gatita Tribalera ☆ Swine Daily

    26 Nov 2026, 23:00 – 27 Nov 2026, 04:00

    Fuchs2, ostrov Štvanice, 170 00 Praha 7-Holešovice, Czechia

    TICKETS: ra.co/events/2574822 Addly Muff is a Mexican DJ, producer, and visual artist from the outskirts of the State of Mexico. She has gained recognition within the underground electronic scene for her energetic sound, which blends club music with Latin American rhythms. She is a co-founder of the independent music collective and label NACA WorldWide – a project led by trans women that serves as a vital platform for increasing the visibility of queer and trans artists in the region. Through her work, including projects such as Rompebocinas and Furia Trans, she integrates music production with activism, creating safe, inclusive spaces for expressing identity through dance and club culture.


    Gatita Triablera is a Prague-based, Mexico-born queer crossover electronic artist driving the narrative of avant-garde electronic ritualism.
